newsitem.title: CHINA: China says finds big copper porphyry deposit.
newsitem.headline: China says finds big copper porphyry deposit.

text.p: China has discovered a major copper porphyry deposit in the southwestern province of Yunnan, officials said on Tuesday.

The deposit -- estimated at 1.0 million tonnes -- is in Jinggu county on the outskirts of the provincial capital Kunming, an official of the China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corporation told Reuters by telephone.

The official at the company's Southwestern Geologic Exploration Bureau said the deposit would yield at least 100,000 tonnes of copper although three years of evaluation and preparation would be required before mining could begin.
But he added this area was seen as a major future copper base for China.
A Hong Kong exploration company has agreed to jointly survey the deposit, he said without giving further details.
